This PKGBUILD follows standard Arch Linux packaging conventions with no evidence of malicious behavior. The package builds and installs using cmake into the standard `$pkgdir` staging directory, and dependencies are clearly declared. The source is fetched from the package's own GitHub repository (`github.com/Sonic-DE/sonic-frameworks-io-extras`) via a tagged release tarball, and a valid SHA-256 checksum is provided (not skipped). No obfuscated code, suspicious network requests, or unexpected system modifications are present.

Key observations: there are no shell injection vectors in the build/package functions since all variables are properly quoted; no files are downloaded or executed outside of standard build/install procedures; and no post-install hooks or system configuration changes are present. The package provides `kio-extras` and conflicts with it, which is normal for a fork/replacement package. Overall, this is a conventional and well-formed AUR package.
